amplificationAnalysis.winnerStatus: No confirmed winner can be declared yet because observed BOOTH sales, note sales/PV and Microsoft Store acquisition/install/CVR metrics are still absent. Do not convert asset density into a fabricated demand signal.

evidence: Two complementary BOOTH assets are already buyer-visible: event operations OS and sponsor CRM.
Two paid note articles are reader-visible in the same operational funnel: sponsor pipeline management and event-day manual design.
Four free acquisition tools already cover event checklist/reception and sponsor plan/email workflows.
The existing event_sponsor_bundle requires low incremental production work because both paid source assets are already published.
provisionalCandidates.cannibalizationConcern: Low for bundle and post-contract tracker if each solves a distinct stage; moderate if event-risk content duplicates the event operations OS without deeper risk workflow.
provisionalCandidates.productionCost: low for bundle; medium for distinct new tracker/OS
provisionalCandidates.guardrail: Proceed with the low-cost coherent bundle as a quota-qualified candidate, but do not launch a large series until actual sales/CVR signals appear.

evidence: One buyer-visible BOOTH thesis/research progress OS exists.
One reader-visible paid note article on seven-box thesis progress management exists.
Four free tools already cover thesis deadline planning, progress diagnosis, weekly planning and research-question design.
The assets map to distinct stages of one research workflow, reducing cross-sell friction.
provisionalCandidates.cannibalizationConcern: Low if interview coding focuses on qualitative analysis rather than general progress management.
provisionalCandidates.guardrail: Keep as second cluster until sales/PV or free-tool referral data confirm demand.

evidence: Free tools now cover handover, role assignment, meeting actions and agenda timeboxing.
A handover BOOTH OS and handover paid note article are in the publication pipeline but are not yet strict-publication verified.
The cluster solves linked operational problems with clear functional separation, but paid demand has not yet been observed.
provisionalCandidates.cannibalizationConcern: Moderate if role/handover products repeat the same checklists; require clear RACI/load/backup-owner differentiation.
provisionalCandidates.guardrail: First verify the existing handover paid assets; only then use paid performance to decide whether to expand the series.

measurementPriority: Capture BOOTH sales by product/date before declaring a paid winner.
Capture note sales/PV/likes by article before amplifying a note series.
Capture Microsoft Store page views/acquisitions/installs/CVR before creating app derivatives.
Add measurable campaign/referral identifiers from free tools to paid/Store destinations when a verified destination exists.

rules: At the next PC-available production run, service carried debt before treating today's quota as satisfied.
If the active candidate cannot reach strict buyer/reader-visible verification quickly, defer it and switch to a fallback candidate.
Maintain more qualified candidates than the remaining hard minimum so a blocked item does not stall the day.
Queue insertion, local success, admin/editor URLs and commits do not count as publication.
Do not publish near-duplicate low-value products merely to satisfy count; use a distinct qualified fallback instead.
Do not require Windows execution after 01:00 JST; cloud preparation continues and debt remains intact.
Do not label a product or cluster a winner without observed performance evidence; provisional clusters may be prioritized only for low-cost, coherent experiments.
